maria (CS Lead): Heads-up: Greenfield Health asked for an SLO reconciliation packet ahead of their renewal. They flagged Mar 10-15 onboarding for latency and are requesting credits. Can we compile evidence + proposed response by Thursday EOD? @tom @ryan @alisa
tom (SRE): I'll pull incident timeline. Noted a regional DB retry storm on Mar 12 ~09:40-09:55 UTC; automatic routing cutover mitigated most requests.
ryan (Data): I'll export p95/p99 and request counts for Mar 1-31. Quick sample: period,uptime,p95_ms,p99_ms,requests
2024-03-01_to_2024-03-31,99.906,132,360,812_340
alisa (AE): Contract excerpt: monthly uptime SLO = 99.9%; p95 latency target = 150ms. Customer claims p95 breaches on Mar12.
tom (SRE): Mar12 outage reduced regional uptime to 99.45 for ~15m window; global monthly stayed above 99.9 after fallback. I'll include trace IDs and the rollback note: rollback at 2024-03-12T09:56Z by @sam.
ryan (Data): Sampling note: p95 computed on edge request latencies, retries deduped by request_id. p99 computed on full sample with no tail-trim.
maria (CS Lead): Deliverables: (1) metrics CSV and sample traces, (2) short cover note explaining root cause & why no credit due (if that's what we recommend), (3) credit calc table showing how contract maps to credits.
alisa (AE): If we show global monthly uptime >99.9 and p95 under target overall, recommend we offer a goodwill: one free enablement deep-dive instead of a credit.
notes-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/greenfield/mar_evidence_v2.zip
maria (CS Lead): Let's review Thu 09:30 PT for 20m. Action items: ryan -> CSV + sampling paragraph by Wed 17:00 PT; tom -> traces + rollback excerpt by Thu 08:30 PT; alisa -> contract clause and customer negotiation options. I'll draft the cover note.
